name: admin
description: Full access to all resources, including user and role management.

name: manager
description: Day-to-day operational access to invoices, products, and users. Cannot manage roles.

name: accountant
description: Reads and writes invoices, reads the product catalog. No user management.

name: viewer
description: Read-only access across invoices, products, and users.

name: platform-admin
description: Operates the platform itself: creates organizations and their first administrator. A Keycloak realm role; grants nothing inside any organization.
